title: APIs
hook: Apps talk to apps without a human clicking — that’s an API call.

steps.caption: App A sends a structured request to App B’s API — no browser UI required.

nodeCaptions.appA: Could be your backend, a mobile app, or a cron job.
nodeCaptions.api: Contract: URLs, methods, auth, JSON shapes.

steps.caption: App B handles it and returns a machine-readable response.

nodeCaptions.appB: Same request/response idea as the web — consumers are programs.

takeaways: APIs are contracts for machine-to-machine requests.
HTTP JSON APIs are common; the pattern isn’t limited to HTTP.
Versioning and auth matter because other programs depend on you.

quiz.question: What is an API primarily for?
choices: Letting programs request work/data from other programs
quiz.explanation: Human UIs are optional — the interface is for software.
